name: Vivify — land becomes a 3/3 creature and is still a land
notes: Memory: project_vivify_becomes_fix_2026-04-23 and project_vivify_instant_fix_2026-04-23. 'Target land becomes a 3/3 creature until end of turn. It's still a land.' once left fake subtypes (Until, End, Turn), skipped the contraction, or turned the land into a plain creature. Ancient Den must end as an Artifact Creature Land 3/3 with no subtypes; the untargeted Forest is unaffected.
